Hey everyone, I am currently based in South Africa. I lived in the UK for 12 years and the Turks and Caicos Islands for two and a half years, and I am currently in Jeffreys Bay, a five-minute walk from the beach. I am working as an integrator and fractional COO at the moment.

I have been using Claude for copywriting since 2023 when it first launched; I even had to use a VPN to access it from here. More recently, I have been creating AI agents. I used an API connection to migrate my entire systems from one platform to another. I migrated my WordPress website, LifterLMS, and CourseHub \(complete with 50 videos, lessons, and workbooks\) over to HighLevel. The videos were on Vimeo, and I rebuilt everything in that all-in-one system. I did this through back-end API connections, getting Claude code to help me download everything, upload it, and rebuild it Using the actual page builder and not hard-coding.

What I would love to be able to do is take on some AI consulting clients and perhaps do some builds for them. I want to put into use all of the things I have learned over the years teaching people how to launch, run their webinars, and manage their marketing, but now add the layer of AI.

I know how to create an AI brain, skills, wiki, etc., and for my own business, I have done that and saved everything to a Google Drive folder that is also on my desktop and in the cloud. I also work as a fractional COO integrator for a UK-based company, and we have team members all over the world.
What I want to know is how we set this up in a company setting so that everybody can access the skills. Perhaps there are certain team members who can update skills, while others are just able to use and access them.
For example, we want to create an agent that triages the inbox and drafts replies. We also want an agent that turns blog posts into carousels, maintains brand voice, and manages all sorts of things. How do we share this in a company setting?
Note that we are using Claude. The idea is to get more of the team using Claude Code. At the moment, we have a team account with Claude, and you can share a project folder with Markdown files, etc., which works in Claude Chat and Claude Cowork. However, Claude Code cannot access a central AI brain, for example within Claude itself.
metadata.title: How to share AI Brain/OS Skills in a Company setting? So that the team can use Claude Code with the files

metadata.content:
Sam from Metro Detroit.

Day job is Microsoft, Global Solutions Architect on the AI Business Solutions
side. 20 years in enterprise IT architecture before that, Walmart, Comerica,
AARP, that kind of work. So I have spent a long time watching big
companies try to actually adopt this stuff, not just buy it.

Building SamJak AI Consulting on the side. One client right now, a law firm,
AI strategy and implementation. Discovery call, then a report and
recommendations, then ongoing. That one honestly came through a recruiter, not
from anything I built.

Where I am headed is multi-location operators, 3 or more sites. Med spas,
dental groups, boutique fitness franchises, that kind of thing. The pattern I
keep seeing is that location three is where everything breaks. Nobody owns the
process across buildings, reporting gets built by hand every month, and the
whole thing runs on one GM who remembers how it works. That is a problem I know
how to fix and it is basically the same problem I solved at enterprise scale,
just smaller.

The assessment offer framework from Corey's videos is where my audit came from,
so that is what brought me here.

My biggest question: my one client came from a recruiter. Everything I built to
generate clients, content, lists, outreach, has produced nothing. For those of
you who got to client 2 and 3, what actually worked? I am not great at cold
outreach and I have maybe 15 hours a week, so I am trying to figure out where
to put them.
